<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>renzstudiocreatives — Creative Designer</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:wght@400;600;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{--bg:#0c0c0e;--panel:#141416;--or:#ff5a1f;--or2:#ff8a3d;--red:#c9301a;--text:#f5f2ee;--mute:#9b9690;--line:rgba(255,255,255,.1);
box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]){--bg:#0c0c0e}}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{--bg:#0c0c0e}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;scroll-padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px)}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);font:400 17px/1.6 "Plus Jakarta Sans",system-ui,sans-serif;overflow-x:hidden}
a{color:inherit}
#bar{position:fixed;top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);left:0;height:3px;width:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--or),var(--or2));z-index:50}
#glow{position:fixed;width:420px;height:420px;margin:-210px 0 0 -210px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,90,31,.16),transparent 65%);pointer-events:none;z-index:1;left:50%;top:50%}
.wrap{max-width:1180px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px;position:relative;z-index:2}
h1,h2,h3{margin:0;line-height:1.05;letter-spacing:-.03em;font-weight:800}
h2{font-size:clamp(30px,5vw,56px)}
.eye{color:var(--or);font-weight:600;font-size:20px;margin-bottom:14px;display:block}
p{color:var(--mute);margin:0}
.pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;background:#fff;color:#111;font-weight:800;font-size:14px;padding:7px 7px 7px 20px;border-radius:999px;text-decoration:none;transition:transform .2s}
.pill b{display:grid;place-items:center;width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--or);color:#fff;transition:transform .3s}
.pill:hover,.pill:focus-visible{transform:scale(1.05);outline:none}.pill:hover b{transform:rotate(-45deg)}
.pill.o{background:var(--or);color:#fff}.pill.o b{background:#fff;color:var(--or)}
/* hero */
.hero{position:relative;margin:0 12px;border-radius:0 0 48px 48px;overflow:hidden;background:radial-gradient(ellipse 65% 75% at 12% 15%,#ff7a30,#e8401c 42%,transparent 78%),radial-gradient(ellipse 45% 65% at 80% 50%,#a3160f,transparent 72%),#3a0709;min-height:max(100vh,700px);isolation:isolate}.nw{position:static!important}
.hero:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent 55%,rgba(12,12,14,.65));z-index:2;pointer-events:none}
nav{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:22px 0;position:relative;z-index:5}
nav .l{font-weight:800;font-size:clamp(16px,4.6vw,21px);letter-spacing:-.02em;text-decoration:none;color:#1a0a06;background:rgba(255,255,255,.14);padding:8px 16px;border-radius:999px;backdrop-filter:blur(6px);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.3)}
nav .m{display:flex;gap:28px;align-items:center;font-size:14px}nav .m a{text-decoration:none;opacity:.9}nav .m a:hover{opacity:1}
.photo{position:absolute;right:3%;bottom:0;height:88%;aspect-ratio:896/1200;z-index:1;will-change:transform}
.photo img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;-webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(to right,transparent,#000 38%,#000 85%,transparent),linear-gradient(to bottom,transparent,#000 14%,#000 70%,transparent);-webkit-mask-composite:source-in;mask-image:linear-gradient(to right,transparent,#000 38%,#000 85%,transparent),linear-gradient(to bottom,transparent,#000 14%,#000 70%,transparent);mask-composite:intersect;filter:saturate(1.1) contrast(1.05)}
.hint{position:relative;z-index:4;padding-top:13vh;max-width:620px}
.hint small{font-size:22px;font-weight:600;display:block;margin-bottom:6px}
.hint h1{font-size:clamp(48px,8.5vw,116px)}
.tag{max-width:380px;margin-top:24px;font-size:18px;font-weight:500;line-height:1.5;color:rgba(255,255,255,.9)}
.nums{position:absolute;z-index:4;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);width:min(1132px,calc(100% - 48px));bottom:30px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,auto);justify-content:space-between;gap:14px 20px;padding-top:20px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.28)}
.nums div{font-size:14px;color:#fff}.nums i{font-style:normal;color:#ffd0b4;font-size:12px;display:block;font-weight:800}
/* marquee */
.mq{overflow:hidden;padding:46px 0;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:30px}
.mq span.t{font-size:12px;font-weight:800;min-width:110px;padding-left:24px;color:var(--mute)}
.track{display:flex;gap:60px;white-space:nowrap;animation:mq 28s linear infinite;font-weight:800;font-size:22px;color:#cfc9c2}
.track em{font-style:normal;color:var(--or)}
@keyframes mq{to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}
/* quote */
.quote{padding:130px 0;text-align:center}
.q{font-size:clamp(28px,5.2vw,64px);font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.03em;line-height:1.12;max-width:1000px;margin:0 auto}
.q span{color:#3a3633;transition:color .3s}.q span.on{color:var(--text)}.q span.on.k{color:var(--or)}
.qmark{font-size:120px;line-height:.6;color:var(--or);font-weight:800;display:block;animation:fl 4s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes fl{50%{transform:translateY(-10px)}}
.by{margin-top:30px;font-weight:600;color:var(--mute)}
/* sections */
section{padding:90px 0}
.split{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:50px;align-items:end}
.split p.big{font-size:clamp(20px,2.4vw,28px);font-weight:600;color:var(--text);line-height:1.3;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:16px;margin-top:60px}
.stat{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:24px;padding:26px}
.stat b{font-size:clamp(34px,5vw,58px);font-weight:800;color:var(--or);display:block;line-height:1}
.cards{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:18px;margin-top:50px}
.card{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:28px;padding:30px;min-height:340px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-end;position:relative;overflow:hidden;transition:transform .2s,border-color .3s}
.card:before{content:"";position:absolute;top:30px;left:30px;right:30px;height:3px;background:var(--or);border-radius:3px;transform-origin:left;transition:transform .6s}
.card:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:auto -30% -60% -30%;height:80%;background:radial-gradient(ellipse,rgba(255,90,31,.25),transparent 70%);opacity:0;transition:opacity .4s}
.card:hover{border-color:rgba(255,90,31,.6)}.card:hover:after{opacity:1}
.card small{color:var(--or);font-weight:800;font-size:14px;margin-bottom:8px}
.card h3{font-size:28px;margin-bottom:10px}.card p{font-size:15px;position:relative;z-index:2}
.tl{margin-top:50px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:200px 1fr auto;gap:20px;padding:26px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);align-items:center;transition:padding .3s}
.row:hover{padding-left:16px}.row time{color:var(--or);font-weight:800;font-size:14px}.row h3{font-size:24px}
.row span{color:var(--mute);font-size:15px}
.works{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:16px;margin-top:50px}
.w{aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:22px;padding:18px;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;font-weight:800;font-size:18px;line-height:1.1;letter-spacing:-.02em;position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:linear-gradient(140deg,var(--or),var(--red));transition:transform .3s}
.w:nth-child(3n+2){background:linear-gradient(140deg,#262628,#101012);border:1px solid var(--line)}
.w:nth-child(3n){background:linear-gradient(140deg,var(--or2),#a82d12)}
.w:nth-child(5n+1){transform:translateY(var(--p,0))}
.w:hover{transform:scale(1.04) rotate(-1.5deg)}
.gal{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr);grid-auto-rows:110px;gap:14px;margin-top:50px}.gal .slot:nth-child(1){grid-column:span 3;grid-row:span 3}.gal .slot:nth-child(2){grid-column:span 3;grid-row:span 2}.gal .slot:nth-child(3){grid-column:span 3}.gal .slot:nth-child(n+4){grid-column:span 2;grid-row:span 2}.vids{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:18px;margin-top:50px}.vids .slot{aspect-ratio:9/16}.slot.vd{border-style:solid;border-color:rgba(255,90,31,.5);background:#000}.slot.vd video{object-fit:contain;background:#000}.vids .slot.land{grid-column:1/-1;aspect-ratio:16/9;max-width:none;width:100%}.yt{position:absolute;top:12px;left:12px;z-index:3;background:rgba(12,12,14,.75);color:#fff;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;padding:6px 12px;border-radius:999px;text-decoration:none;backdrop-filter:blur(6px)}.yt:hover{background:var(--or)}.slot{margin:0;position:relative;overflow:hidden;border:2px dashed rgba(255,255,255,.22);border-radius:24px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;color:var(--mute);font-weight:600;font-size:14px;background:repeating-linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,255,255,.03) 0 12px,transparent 12px 24px);transition:border-color .3s,color .3s,transform .3s}.slot:hover{border-color:var(--or);color:var(--text);transform:scale(1.02)}.slot svg{width:34px;height:34px;color:var(--or)}.slot.vl{text-decoration:none;color:var(--text);border-style:solid;border-color:rgba(255,90,31,.6);background:linear-gradient(160deg,rgba(255,90,31,.3),rgba(12,12,14,.85))}.slot img,.slot video{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}.play{width:68px;height:68px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--or);display:grid;place-items:center;animation:pl 2.4s infinite}.play svg{color:#fff;width:26px;height:26px;margin-left:3px}@keyframes pl{0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(255,90,31,.6)}100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 22px rgba(255,90,31,0)}}@media(max-width:860px){.gal{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;grid-auto-rows:150px}.gal .slot:nth-child(n){grid-column:span 1;grid-row:span 1}.gal .slot:nth-child(1){grid-column:span 2;grid-row:span 2}.vids{grid-template-columns:1fr}.vids .slot{aspect-ratio:9/16;max-width:340px;margin:0 auto;width:100%}}
.ph{margin:0;transition:transform .4s}.frame{position:relative;padding:11px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#34343a,#0b0b0d);border-radius:52px;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #46464d,0 34px 60px rgba(255,90,31,.28);animation:fl 6s ease-in-out infinite}
.frame:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:50%;top:21px;width:30%;height:24px;margin-left:-15%;background:#000;border-radius:20px;z-index:3}
.frame:after{content:"";position:absolute;left:-5px;top:100px;width:4px;height:30px;background:#46464d;border-radius:3px 0 0 3px;box-shadow:0 52px 0 #46464d,0 100px 0 #46464d}
.frame .pw{position:absolute;right:-5px;top:150px;width:4px;height:70px;background:#46464d;border-radius:0 3px 3px 0}
.frame .hb{position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:20px;width:34%;height:5px;margin-left:-17%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.75);border-radius:5px;z-index:3;box-shadow:0 0 6px rgba(0,0,0,.5)}
.ph img{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;border-radius:42px}.ph:nth-child(2) .frame{animation-delay:-2s}.ph:nth-child(3) .frame{animation-delay:-4s}.ph:hover{transform:translateY(-12px) rotate(-1deg)}.ph figcaption{margin-top:-4px;text-align:center}.ph figcaption b{display:block;font-size:17px}.ph figcaption span{color:var(--mute);font-size:14px}@media(max-width:860px){}
.frame{container-type:inline-size}.hand{position:absolute;z-index:5;left:-8.8cqw;top:calc(100% - 58.8cqw);width:117.6cqw;height:94cqw;overflow:visible;pointer-events:none}
.ptl{position:relative;margin-top:60px}.rail{position:absolute;left:12.5%;right:12.5%;top:27px;height:3px;background:var(--line);border-radius:3px}.rail .fill{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;bottom:0;width:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--or),var(--or2));border-radius:3px;box-shadow:0 0 14px var(--or);transition:width .6s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)}.pg{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:18px;position:relative}.pcol{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:22px}.pn{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:none;border:0;color:var(--mute);font:800 13px "Plus Jakarta Sans",system-ui,sans-serif;cursor:pointer}.pn b{display:grid;place-items:center;width:56px;height:56px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--panel);border:2px solid var(--line);color:var(--text);font-size:20px;transition:all .4s}.pn:focus-visible b{outline:2px solid #fff}.pcol.reached .pn b{border-color:var(--or)}.pcol.on .pn{color:var(--text)}.pcol.on .pn b{background:var(--or);border-color:var(--or);transform:scale(1.15);box-shadow:0 0 0 8px rgba(255,90,31,.2),0 0 28px rgba(255,90,31,.6)}.pc{width:100%;min-height:200px;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:28px;padding:28px;cursor:pointer;filter:blur(7px);opacity:.32;transform:scale(.96);transition:filter .5s,opacity .5s,transform .5s,border-color .5s;user-select:none}.pc h3{font-size:26px;margin-bottom:10px}.pc p{font-size:15px}.pcol.on .pc{filter:none;opacity:1;transform:scale(1.03);border-color:rgba(255,90,31,.7);box-shadow:0 20px 50px rgba(255,90,31,.15)}@media(max-width:860px){.pg{grid-template-columns:1fr}.rail{display:none}.pc{min-height:0}}
.phs{display:flex;gap:10px;overflow-x:auto;scroll-snap-type:x mandatory;margin-top:50px;padding:10px 0 24px;scrollbar-width:thin;scrollbar-color:var(--or) transparent;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch}.ph{flex:0 0 min(500px,86vw);scroll-snap-align:center;margin:0}.hm{position:relative;width:100%;animation:fl 6s ease-in-out infinite;-webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(#000 84%,transparent 98%);mask-image:linear-gradient(#000 84%,transparent 98%)}.ph:nth-child(2) .hm{animation-delay:-2s}.ph:nth-child(3) .hm{animation-delay:-4s}.scr{position:absolute;left:var(--sx);top:var(--sy);width:var(--sw);height:var(--sh);overflow:hidden;background:#000;border-radius:30px}.scr img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:top;display:block}.hmimg{position:relative;z-index:2;display:block;width:100%;height:auto;pointer-events:none;filter:drop-shadow(0 22px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.55))}.swipe{display:block;text-align:right;color:var(--mute);font-size:13px;font-weight:600;margin-top:14px}
.stage{position:relative;width:100%;perspective:1100px;padding-top:4%}
.tb{position:absolute;left:-2%;right:-2%;bottom:3%;height:46%;background:linear-gradient(#4a2c1c,#170b08);border-radius:26px;box-shadow:inset 0 2px 0 rgba(255,200,150,.22),0 20px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.45);transform:rotateX(58deg);transform-origin:50% 100%;opacity:1;transition:opacity 1.2s .9s}
.ph.go .tb{opacity:0}
.hm{animation:none;-webkit-mask-image:none;mask-image:none;transform-origin:50% 90%;transform:rotateX(74deg) scale(.88) translateY(2%);transition:transform 1.4s cubic-bezier(.2,1.25,.3,1) .9s}
.ph.go .hm{transform:none;animation:hold 7s ease-in-out 2.5s infinite}
.hmimg{image-rendering:auto;opacity:0;transform:translate(calc(var(--dir,1)*48%),44%) rotate(calc(var(--dir,1)*18deg));transition:transform .9s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1),opacity .5s;-webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(#000 86%,transparent 99%);mask-image:linear-gradient(#000 86%,transparent 99%)}
.ph.go .hmimg{opacity:1;transform:none;animation:reach 1.1s cubic-bezier(.25,.7,.25,1) both,sway 6s ease-in-out 2.4s infinite}@keyframes reach{0%{opacity:0;transform:translate(48%,44%) rotate(18deg)}55%{opacity:1;transform:translate(10%,8%) rotate(-5deg)}80%{opacity:1;transform:translate(-1%,-1%) rotate(1.5deg)}100%{opacity:1;transform:none}}@keyframes sway{0%,100%{transform:none}50%{transform:translate(.4%,.6%) rotate(-.7deg)}}@keyframes hold{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0) rotate(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-9px) rotate(.5deg)}}
.scr{box-shadow:0 0 0 8px #0d0d10,0 0 0 10px #44444b,0 30px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.55)}
.scr:after{content:"";position:absolute;left:22.5%;width:55%;top:0;height:4%;background:#000;border-radius:0 0 16px 16px;z-index:2}
.ph{cursor:pointer}
.mqr{overflow:hidden;margin:18px -24px 0;padding:14px 0;-webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#000 7%,#000 93%,transparent);mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#000 7%,#000 93%,transparent)}.trk{display:flex;gap:18px;width:max-content;animation:mqv 70s linear infinite}.trk.rev{animation-direction:reverse}.trk:hover{animation-play-state:paused}@keyframes mqv{to{transform:translateX(calc(-50% - 9px))}}.gi{margin:0;position:relative;flex:none;border-radius:22px;overflow:hidden;cursor:zoom-in;transition:transform .35s,box-shadow .35s;box-shadow:0 14px 34px rgba(0,0,0,.45)}.gi img{display:block;height:clamp(250px,32vw,360px);width:auto}.gi:hover{transform:translateY(-10px) scale(1.04) rotate(-1deg);box-shadow:0 24px 50px rgba(255,90,31,.35);z-index:3}.gi figcaption{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;padding:34px 16px 14px;font-weight:800;font-size:14px;color:#fff;background:linear-gradient(transparent,rgba(0,0,0,.8));opacity:0;transform:translateY(10px);transition:all .3s}.gi:hover figcaption{opacity:1;transform:none}.lb{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:100;display:none;place-items:center;background:rgba(8,6,6,.92);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);padding:24px;cursor:zoom-out}.lb.on{display:grid}.lb img{max-width:min(92vw,820px);max-height:88vh;border-radius:20px;box-shadow:0 30px 80px rgba(255,90,31,.3)}.lb button{position:absolute;top:calc(14px + env(safe-area-inset-top,0px));right:18px;width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;border:0;background:var(--or);color:#fff;font-size:28px;line-height:1;cursor:pointer}
.chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;margin-top:20px}
.ic{width:24px;height:24px;flex:none}.chip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;border:1px solid var(--line);padding:9px 20px 9px 12px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:600;font-size:15px;background:var(--panel);transition:all .25s}
.chip:hover{background:var(--or);border-color:var(--or);transform:translateY(-4px)}
.toolcol{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:30px;margin-top:40px}.toolcol h3{font-size:16px;color:var(--or)}
.steps{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:18px;margin-top:50px;counter-reset:s}
.step{border-left:2px solid var(--line);padding-left:20px;counter-increment:s;transition:border-color .4s}
.step.in{border-color:var(--or)}
.step:before{content:"0" counter(s);font-size:48px;font-weight:800;color:var(--or);display:block;line-height:1;margin-bottom:12px}
.step h3{font-size:20px;margin-bottom:8px}.step p{font-size:15px}
.stairs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:16px;align-items:end;margin-top:70px}
.stairs .card{min-height:0;padding:26px}.stairs .card:before{display:none}
.stairs .card:nth-child(1){margin-bottom:0}.stairs .card:nth-child(2){margin-bottom:34px}.stairs .card:nth-child(3){margin-bottom:68px}.stairs .card:nth-child(4){margin-bottom:102px}
.cta{margin:0 12px;border-radius:48px;padding:110px 0;text-align:center;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 30% 20%,#ff8a3d,#e8401c 50%,#5a1008);position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.cta h2{font-size:clamp(38px,7vw,96px);max-width:900px;margin:0 auto 34px}
.cta .big{display:block;font-size:clamp(18px,3vw,30px);font-weight:800;margin:10px 0;text-decoration:none;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.cta .big:hover{text-decoration:underline}
.orb{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.12);animation:fl 7s ease-in-out infinite}
footer{text-align:center;padding:40px 24px;color:var(--mute);font-size:14px}
.rv{opacity:0;transform:translateY(40px);transition:opacity .8s,transform .8s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)}
.rv.in{opacity:1;transform:none}
@media(max-width:860px){nav .m a:not(.pill){display:none}.photo{height:56%;right:-16%}.hint{padding-top:5vh}.hint h1{font-size:clamp(44px,13vw,72px)}.nums{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;bottom:20px}.split,.cards,.steps,.stairs,.toolcol{grid-template-columns:1fr}.stats{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.works{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.row{grid-template-columns:1fr}.stairs .card{margin-bottom:0!important}.hero{border-radius:0 0 32px 32px}.tag{max-width:270px;font-size:15px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}.rv{opacity:1;transform:none}}

.pgal{margin-top:50px;position:relative}
.pgt{display:flex;gap:22px;overflow-x:auto;padding:40px 24px 50px;margin:0 -24px;cursor:grab;scrollbar-width:none;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;touch-action:pan-x pan-y}
.pgt::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}.pgt.drag{cursor:grabbing}.pgt.drag .pc2{pointer-events:none}
.pc2{flex:0 0 auto;height:min(460px,62vw);aspect-ratio:var(--ar);margin:0;position:relative;overflow:hidden;border-radius:26px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--panel);transform:translateY(var(--y,0)) rotate(var(--r,0deg));transition:transform .45s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1),border-color .3s,box-shadow .4s;user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none}
.pc2:nth-child(odd){--y:0px}.pc2:nth-child(even){--y:34px}
.pc2:nth-child(3n+1){--r:-1.6deg}.pc2:nth-child(3n+2){--r:1.2deg}.pc2:nth-child(3n){--r:-.6deg}
.pc2:hover{transform:translateY(calc(var(--y,0px) - 14px)) rotate(0) scale(1.04);border-color:rgba(255,90,31,.7);box-shadow:0 26px 50px rgba(255,90,31,.22);z-index:3}
.pc2 img{position:absolute;top:0;left:-9%;width:118%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transform:translateX(var(--px,0px));transition:filter .4s;pointer-events:none}
.pc2:hover img{filter:saturate(1.15)}
.pc2:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent 55%,rgba(12,12,14,.85));pointer-events:none}
.pc2 figcaption{position:absolute;left:20px;right:20px;bottom:18px;z-index:2;display:flex;flex-direction:column;transform:translateY(8px);transition:transform .4s}
.pc2:hover figcaption{transform:none}
.pc2 small{color:var(--or2);font-weight:800;font-size:12px}.pc2 b{font-size:20px;letter-spacing:-.02em;line-height:1.15}.pc2 span{font-size:13px;color:#d6d0c9;opacity:.85}
.pgp{height:3px;background:var(--line);border-radius:3px;margin:0 auto;max-width:300px;overflow:hidden}.pgp i{display:block;height:100%;width:20%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--or),var(--or2));border-radius:3px}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.pc2{transition:none}}
</style></head><body>

<section id="process"><div class="wrap"><span class="eye rv">How we work</span><h2 class="rv">My creative process</h2>
<div class="steps">
<div class="step rv"><h3>Let’s connect</h3><p>Book a free discovery call to discuss your ideas, goals, and project needs.</p></div>
<div class="step rv"><h3>Make it official</h3><p>If we’re a good fit, we’ll finalize the details and sign the contract.</p></div>
<div class="step rv"><h3>Set the direction</h3><p>I’ll send the creative brief and visual direction before we begin.</p></div>
<div class="step rv"><h3>Let’s create</h3><p>Once everything is aligned, we’ll bring your vision to life.</p></div></div>
<h2 class="rv" style="margin-top:100px">Project timeline</h2>
<div class="ptl rv" id="ptl"><div class="rail"><i class="fill"></i></div><div class="pg"><div class="pcol on reached" data-i="0"><button class="pn" type="button" aria-label="Step 1: Plan"><b>1</b>Step 1</button><div class="pc"><h3>Plan</h3><p>Plan the month’s content ahead. <script>
(function(){
var bar=document.getElementById('bar'),ph=document.getElementById('ph'),q=document.getElementById('q'),gl=document.getElementById('glow');
var ks=(q.dataset.k||'').split(',');
q.innerHTML=q.textContent.split(' ').map(function(w){var k=ks.indexOf(w.replace(/[^a-z.]/gi,'').toLowerCase())>-1;return '<span'+(k?' class="k"':'')+'>'+w+'</span>'}).join(' ');
var qs=q.querySelectorAll('span');
var D=['Birthday greeting','Sunday service','Caroling contest','Volunteer with us','Faith series','Will you… come to church','God Himself will','God can turn it for your good','God is with you through it all','Destroy the false altar'],wk=document.getElementById('wk');
D.forEach(function(n){var d=document.createElement('div');d.className='w rv';d.textContent=n;wk.appendChild(d)});
var tr=document.getElementById('tr');tr.innerHTML+=tr.innerHTML;
function sc(){var h=document.documentElement.scrollHeight-innerHeight,y=scrollY;bar.style.width=(y/h*100)+'%';
if(y<innerHeight*1.2)ph.style.transform='translateY('+y*.14+'px) scale('+(1+y/4000)+')';
var r=q.getBoundingClientRect(),pr=Math.min(1,Math.max(0,(innerHeight*.85-r.top)/(innerHeight*.6+r.height)));
var on=Math.round(pr*qs.length);qs.forEach(function(s,i){s.classList.toggle('on',i<on)});
document.querySelectorAll('.w').forEach(function(w,i){if(i%5==0){var b=w.getBoundingClientRect();w.style.setProperty('--p',((b.top-innerHeight/2)*.08)+'px')}})}
addEventListener('scroll',sc,{passive:true});sc();
addEventListener('mousemove',function(e){gl.style.left=e.clientX+'px';gl.style.top=e.clientY+'px'});
var io=new IntersectionObserver(function(en){en.forEach(function(e){if(!e.isIntersecting)return;var el=e.target;el.classList.add('in');
if(el.dataset&&el.dataset.n)cnt(el);el.querySelectorAll&&el.querySelectorAll('[data-n]').forEach(cnt);io.unobserve(el)})},{threshold:.15});
document.querySelectorAll('.rv,.step').forEach(function(el,i){el.style.transitionDelay=(i%4)*90+'ms';io.observe(el)});
function cnt(el){if(el.done)return;el.done=1;var n=+el.dataset.n,v=0,st=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(n/50)),s=el.dataset.s||'';var iv=setInterval(function(){v=Math.min(n,v+st);el.textContent=v+s;if(v>=n)clearInterval(iv)},30)}
document.querySelectorAll('.card,.stat').forEach(function(el){el.addEventListener('mousemove',function(e){var r=el.getBoundingClientRect();el.style.transform='perspective(700px) rotateY('+((e.clientX-r.left)/r.width-.5)*7+'deg) rotateX('+(-((e.clientY-r.top)/r.height-.5))*7+'deg)'});el.addEventListener('mouseleave',function(){el.style.transform=''})});
document.querySelectorAll('.vids video').forEach(function(v){new IntersectionObserver(function(e){if(e[0].isIntersecting){v.play().catch(function(){})}else{v.pause()}},{threshold:.5}).observe(v)});
})();
(function(){var t=document.getElementById('ptl');if(!t)return;var cols=t.querySelectorAll('.pcol'),fill=t.querySelector('.fill');function go(i){cols.forEach(function(c,k){c.classList.toggle('on',k===i);c.classList.toggle('reached',k<=i)});fill.style.width=(i/3*100)+'%'}t.addEventListener('click',function(e){var c=e.target.closest('.pcol');if(c)go(+c.dataset.i)});go(0)})();
(function(){var io=new IntersectionObserver(function(en){en.forEach(function(e){if(e.intersectionRatio>=.6)e.target.classList.add('go');else if(e.intersectionRatio<.12)e.target.classList.remove('go')})},{threshold:[0,.12,.6,.9]});document.querySelectorAll('.ph').forEach(function(p){io.observe(p);p.addEventListener('click',function(){p.classList.remove('go');setTimeout(function(){p.classList.add('go')},80)})})})();
(function(){var lb=document.getElementById('lb'),li=lb.querySelector('img');function cl(){lb.classList.remove('on')}document.querySelectorAll('.gi').forEach(function(g){g.addEventListener('click',function(){var im=g.querySelector('img');li.src=im.src;li.alt=im.alt;lb.classList.add('on')})});lb.addEventListener('click',cl);addEventListener('keydown',function(e){if(e.key==='Escape')cl()});
document.querySelectorAll('.trk').forEach(function(t){[].slice.call(t.children).forEach(function(c){var k=c.cloneNode(true);k.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');t.appendChild(k)})});document.querySelectorAll('.trk .gi').forEach(function(g){if(!g.dataset.b){g.dataset.b=1;g.addEventListener('click',function(){var im=g.querySelector('img');li.src=im.src;li.alt=im.alt;lb.classList.add('on')})}});
var an=[].map.call(document.querySelectorAll('.trk'),function(t){return t.getAnimations()[0]}).filter(Boolean),ly=scrollY,v=1;addEventListener('scroll',function(){var d=Math.abs(scrollY-ly);ly=scrollY;v=Math.min(8,Math.max(v,1+d/6))},{passive:true});
(function loop(){v+=(1-v)*.05;an.forEach(function(a){a.updatePlaybackRate(v)});requestAnimationFrame(loop)})()})();
</script><script>(function(){var t=document.getElementById('pgt'),pi=document.getElementById('pgi'),lb=document.getElementById('lb');if(!t||!lb)return;var li=lb.querySelector('img'),cs=[].slice.call(t.children),down=0,sx=0,sl=0,moved=0,hover=0,dir=1,pos=t.scrollLeft,vis=1,last=0;
function upd(){var m=t.scrollWidth-t.clientWidth,tr=t.getBoundingClientRect(),c=tr.left+tr.width/2;pi.style.width=Math.max(12,t.clientWidth/t.scrollWidth*100)+'%';pi.style.marginLeft=(m>0?t.scrollLeft/m*(100-parseFloat(pi.style.width)):0)+'%';cs.forEach(function(e){var r=e.getBoundingClientRect();e.style.setProperty('--px',(-(r.left+r.width/2-c)/tr.width*34)+'px')})}
t.addEventListener('scroll',upd,{passive:true});addEventListener('resize',upd);
t.addEventListener('pointerdown',function(e){if(e.pointerType==='touch')return;down=1;moved=0;sx=e.clientX;sl=t.scrollLeft});
addEventListener('pointermove',function(e){if(!down)return;var d=e.clientX-sx;if(Math.abs(d)>5){moved=1;t.classList.add('drag')}if(moved){t.scrollLeft=sl-d;pos=t.scrollLeft}});
addEventListener('pointerup',function(){down=0;setTimeout(function(){t.classList.remove('drag')},0)});
t.addEventListener('mouseenter',function(){hover=1});t.addEventListener('mouseleave',function(){hover=0});
t.addEventListener('touchstart',function(){hover=1},{passive:true});t.addEventListener('touchend',function(){setTimeout(function(){hover=0},2500)},{passive:true});
t.addEventListener('wheel',function(e){if(Math.abs(e.deltaX)>Math.abs(e.deltaY)){pos=t.scrollLeft}},{passive:true});
cs.forEach(function(c){c.addEventListener('click',function(){if(moved)return;var im=c.querySelector('img');li.src=im.src;li.alt=im.alt;lb.classList.add('on')});
c.addEventListener('mousemove',function(e){var r=c.getBoundingClientRect();c.style.setProperty('--r',(((e.clientX-r.left)/r.width-.5)*4)+'deg')});c.addEventListener('mouseleave',function(){c.style.removeProperty('--r')})});
new IntersectionObserver(function(e){vis=e[0].isIntersecting}).observe(t);
var rm=matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce)').matches;
(function loop(ts){requestAnimationFrame(loop);if(rm||!vis||hover||down)return;var m=t.scrollWidth-t.clientWidth;if(m<=0)return;if(Math.abs(pos-t.scrollLeft)>2)pos=t.scrollLeft;pos+=dir*.45;if(pos>=m){pos=m;dir=-1}else if(pos<=0){pos=0;dir=1}t.scrollLeft=pos})();upd()})();</script></body></html>
